title: A user without the timesheet-reports permission does not see the report in the navigation
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in as a user whose role lacks the permission that controls the Timesheet Activities report.
custom_steps:
1. Open the reports navigation.
2. Look for Technician Utilization under Performance.
custom_expected: 1. The Technician Utilization report does NOT appear in the navigation.
